steps.en: Wire each agent harness you use to report its state
steps.zh: 给你用的每个 agent 接上状态上报

steps.en: Start tuios and run your agents in tiled panes as usual
steps.zh: 启动 tuios，照常在平铺 pane 里跑 agent

steps.en: Daemon keeps the panes alive and marks each agent working / needs input / done / errored
steps.zh: 守护进程托住 pane，给每个 agent 标上工作中、等你、完成或出错

steps.en: Collects approvals, questions and finished turns from every session into one Inbox
steps.zh: 把各会话里的审批、提问、完成的回合收进一个 Inbox

steps.en: Open the Inbox and answer the waiting prompt without going to its pane
steps.zh: 打开 Inbox，不用切到那个 pane 就能直接回答

value.en: No more tabbing through panes to find the agent stuck on a permission prompt; every waiting agent is one list you answer from
value.zh: 不用再挨个 pane 找卡在权限确认上的 agent；所有在等你的 agent 都在一张列表里，就地回答

sources: README Installation (brew install tuios) and Quick Start (tuios: attaches to a daemon-backed session)
docs/AGENT_STATE.md 'Set it up' step 1 (tuios integration install claude-code) and step 2 ('ctrl+b i opens the Inbox')

docs/AGENT_STATE.md 'What you get' (one state per pane: working, needs_input, idle, done, errored; the Inbox lists approvals, questions, mail, errors, finished turns in every session on every machine; answer from there)
docs/SESSIONS.md 'Daemon Sessions' (the daemon owns the PTYs; a client is only a viewer)
